python3 - <<'PY'
import urllib.request, urllib.parse
q=urllib.parse.quote('"Duan Yihe" NUS ECE')
for u in [f'https://www.google.com/search?q={q}', f'https://duckduckgo.com/html/?q={q}', f'https://www.bing.com/search?q={q}']:
    try:
        req=urllib.request.Request(u,headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
        d=urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=20).read().decode('utf-8','ignore')
        print('URL',u,'LEN',len(d))
        open('/tmp/search'+str([f'https://www.google.com/search?q={q}', f'https://duckduckgo.com/html/?q={q}', f'https://www.bing.com/search?q={q}'].index(u))+'.html','w').write(d)
    except Exception as e: print('ERR',u,e)
PY
